listNote: Official PS5 trophy list: 55 trophies (1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze), 28 hidden until earned. Names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, which agree on every entry; guides below are this app's own words and cite their sources per trophy.

sources.label: Exophase — GTA VI PSN trophies (official names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (grades and PSN progress targets)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List (summarising PowerPyx and GTABase)
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List (cross-checking PowerPyx, GTABase, Beebom, CULTR, TechWiser)

trophies.guide: The Platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no separate task: work through the roadmap in this app (story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup) and this is the last one to unlock. PowerPyx rates the full Platinum at roughly 200 hours in a single playthrough, with no difficulty settings to worry about.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion, visible after the story; earlier progress still counts). The checklist asks for less than true completion — for example 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 collectible card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals — and nothing on it is missable. Most of it fills in while you chase the other trophies, so leave the grind for after the credits and mop up what remains.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: stunt jumps (130), flying under bridges (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25). Under-the-bridge flights are reported as the quickest kind to farm. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts, and discovered stunt spots at Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots. Note the 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road too.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges sit at Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero); most challenges have three difficulty tiers and some unlock only after other conditions are met. Check the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges for what is open and what you still need.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full mission strands for strangers. Not every strand counts: GTA Zone, summarising PowerPyx and GTABase, names Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as counting, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. Start strands as soon as they unlock — one source (TechWiser, via EGamers.io) warns some stranger chains may have story-linked windows, so clearing them early is the safe play.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PowerPyx and GTABase via GTA Zone

trophies.guide: Collect every card in any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets scattered across Leonida. Progress lives at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards, and cards you sell at pawn shops still count toward a set. If you are also chasing 100% completion you will need 15 sets, so this trophy comes naturally on that road.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app (hold Up) to scan 100 scannable locations. The pool mixes landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags, and any combination reaching 100 works. Track the running total at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations, and scan as you explore so the count builds during the story instead of in one long sweep at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults and get away. Vaults open up after the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…': follow a security van into a bank while its vault stands open. Expect an instant 4-star wanted level, so stage a fast bike nearby for the escape. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so the remaining three are worth doing on the same sweep.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the 9 activity types in the game at least once. You do not need to win or finish them — a single try of each type is enough — so tick them off as they unlock during the story and check the Activities tab in Progress to see which types remain.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations (some charge an entry fee). Discovered spots appear under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones. Only one win per location is needed for the trophy, but 100% completion asks for all 42 races, so winning the extra races at a location while you are there saves a return trip.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer — repeating the same race does not add to the count. Race locations are tracked at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. If you bring your own car, its Rating matters and can be raised with Mod Shop upgrades; hiring a car at the venue is the simpler option early on.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early in the game Cal messages you with a fishing challenge: catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg in the marked area (a purple icon on the map). You need a boat with a fishing rod — hijacking one nearby works if you do not own one yet. Keep fishing the marked water until a heavy enough fish bites.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find any arcade machine in the world and play one game through to completion. No score target is attached to the trophy — finishing a single arcade game is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida (18 spots across 10 locations per GTABase; the 100% checklist counts 15). A spot only registers once the closing 'zen' animation has played. WARNING — possibly missable: the first meditation, Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is reported to disappear when Chapter 1 ends, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do that first meditation during Chapter 1 to be safe. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PowerPyx and GTABase via GTA Zone (missable warning)

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 in-game Challenges — skill-based tasks listed under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges. Pick the ones that fit how you already play; the 100% checklist raises the bar to 70, so favourites first, then the remainder during cleanup.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Bank vault robberies reliably produce 4 stars, and both PowerPyx and GTABase point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good place to break line of sight and wait out the heat. Stay out of sight until the stars clear with your partner still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row while your partner is with you, keeping your wanted level alive between hits — letting it drop resets the chain. The jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together and make the run easier. If the trophy does not pop after the third shop, GTABase advises robbing a fourth while still wanted.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you get into it or scan it with WAiNK — GTABase notes scanning traffic near busy roads is the efficient route, no driving required. Progress is under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles, and 100% completion asks for 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning new models throughout the story.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Fill your Combat Focus meter first, then trigger it in front of a group of at least five enemies and drop all five before it ends. An assault rifle is the reported tool of choice, and gang members are the reliable targets — cops, soldiers and civilians reportedly do not count toward the five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Clear out a jewelry store's safe without anyone spotting you. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs provide the Snap Gun for opening the back door; from there, find the safe code and empty the safe while staying unseen. If you are detected, leave and try again clean rather than fighting through it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, take its cargo and escape the wanted level that follows. A bank vault job also counts toward this if you get away, per GTA Zone's summary of the guides, so a vault run can earn two trophies' worth of progress at once.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the entire Leonida map. Flying a plane over the dark patches is reported as the fastest way to reveal them, so save a dedicated flight for any regions your story travels never touched and check the map for leftover fog before calling it done.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Only one per gang is needed for the trophy, but 100% completion asks for all 39 operations, so clearing every operation you find on the way builds both at once.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until your lifetime total reaches $250,000. It is a running total, not a single payout, and one fence (Yasmani, per the guides) pays the best rate. The total grows naturally while you run robberies for 100% completion, so funnel bills to the best-paying contact whenever you cash in.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a combined $100,000 in shops of any kind — another running lifetime total. Vehicle upgrades, weapons and property purchases all feed it, and buying the garages for Little Boxes alone covers a large share, so this tends to unlock on its own during a completion run.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties listed for sale (about $160,000 in total through the Vice City Real Estate app); the 4 garages granted by the story do not count. Push Square names the first few: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000) and Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000). Extra garage space also helps with On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which Moses hands you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for the vehicles you register, so buying garages (see Little Boxes) makes this easier. Register vehicles as you collect them rather than in one batch at the end.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the early Chapter 1 mission 'Gone Fishing'. It unlocks automatically as the story plays out and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 1 of the main story. Unmissable. Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the one spot tied to the possibly-missable Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy's guide).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 2 of the main story. Unmissable. Chapter 2 also opens up playing as Jason and Lucia together, which the final meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude requires.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 3 of the main story. Unmissable. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs along the way provide the Snap Gun used by the Sneakthief trophy.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy: finish Chapter 4 of the main story. Unmissable. Chapter 4's optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' is what opens bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal, so take it when it appears.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the final mission of the main story. Unmissable. After the credits Leonida stays open in free roam and the 100% Completion checklist becomes visible, which is when the long cleanup toward A Long Road begins. There is no mission replay or New Game+, but nothing needed for the Platinum is locked behind the ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission 'Breakfast Run' (a Chapter 2 mission per GTABase). Unmissable — it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission 'The Cartel Heist' (Chapter 3 per GTABase). Unmissable — it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission 'Child's Play' (Chapter 4 per GTABase). Unmissable — it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission 'Headliners' (Chapter 4 per GTABase). Unmissable — it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission 'VCIA Takedown' (Chapter 4 per GTABase). Unmissable — it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete the mission 'Operation Savage Glory' (Chapter 5 per GTABase). Unmissable — it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but its own trophy is reason enough to finish it. Start the strand when it unlocks rather than leaving it to the very end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand, ending with the mission 'Maritime Disputes'. Push Square confirms that final mission is the trigger, so follow the strand through rather than stopping at the earlier jobs.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's five jobs, which start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission and stay open after the story; the strand ends with 'Hometown Heroes'. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but finishing it earns this trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Randy's missions, including his vehicle wish-list requests, through to the strand's final mission. Push Square maintains a list of Randy's wish-list vehicle locations if a requested vehicle is hard to find.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete all of Tyrone's missions through to the strand's final mission. Push Square's Kitty Litter Lab locations help with the strand's lab visits. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but it has this trophy of its own.
trophies.name: Spin on This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting quests (Jason-only, opening after Chapter 2) and hunt the unique animal he asks for. As of 19 Nov 2026 the exact animal is not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase, so follow Bret's in-game instructions rather than any specific species named online; this guide will be updated once a cited source pins it down.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA airport, steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off, and get roughly 1 km away from the airport. GTABase reports that distance as the trigger, so keep flying away from VCIA until the trophy pops instead of landing nearby.
trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. GTABase reports the military base as the tank's home; expect a heavy wanted response, so go in prepared and keep moving once you are in the tank.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description points to drinking a cocktail somewhere overlooking Ocean Beach. As of 19 Nov 2026, PowerPyx and GTABase have not pinned down the exact spot or trigger, so treat any specific location claimed online as unconfirmed; try beachfront bars on Ocean Beach and watch for the trophy. This guide cites no exact step because no source has verified one yet.
trophies.name: In the Beginning...

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description suggests driving a car out of a vehicle showroom through its window, in the classic style. GTABase thinks the same, but as of 19 Nov 2026 neither GTABase nor PowerPyx has confirmed the exact showroom or method, so consider the window exit a lead to test, not a verified step.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: GTA Zone's summary of the guides ties this to the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn: rob the operation, then lose the police. The official description's wording is oblique, so treat the bowling-alley operation as the reported route and finish the escape to trigger it.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: GTABase reads 'a partnership with mass appeal' as maxing out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Working out together trains both characters at once, which is the efficient route; keep training until both Strength bars are full.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: GTABase (single source so far) links this to performing 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Caution from both PowerPyx and GTABase: pushing the profile to 'Irredeemable' is permanent, so build the count with reversible choices and check your profile as you go rather than rampaging blindly. Treat the exact count as reported, not confirmed, until a second source verifies it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: PowerPyx and GTABase via EGamers.io (Irredeemable warning)

trophies.guide: The official description — 'Second time's the charm' — hints at succeeding at something on a second attempt, but as of 19 Nov 2026 PowerPyx and GTABase have not identified the exact trigger. This guide claims no specific step: keep an eye on the trophy list after retrying failed activities, and check back once a cited source confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: GTABase suspects this comes from a strange event somewhere in Leonida, matching the baffled official description, but as of 19 Nov 2026 the event and its location are unconfirmed by PowerPyx and GTABase. Explore odd corners of the map and investigate anything unusual; no exact location is claimed here because no source has verified one yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description describes knocking people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — 'bowl 'em over' hints at a target count, possibly ten. As of 19 Nov 2026 PowerPyx and GTABase have not confirmed the exact requirement, so practise melee drive-bys on groups and watch for the pop; no precise count is claimed here until a source verifies it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
